title: Lead Technical Product Manager, Rail Integrations (all genders)
description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for a Lead Technical Product Manager to join our Supply domain, more specifically in the Rail Integrations team, which is responsible for onboarding carriers onto our system (integrating external systems and harmonising data structures). This is key to scaling our business; therefore, our focus is on innovation and automation.

What you will do:

  • Lead and grow a team of Technical Product Managers and Integration Analysts, setting the standard for technical excellence and ownership.

  • Define the strategy for partner integrations — how the world's largest ground transportation marketplace integrates with operators across 70+ countries.

  • Turn integration into a competitive advantage by driving automation, slashing time-to-live, and building scalable infrastructure no competitor can match.

  • Own the roadmap end-to-end — make the tough prioritisation calls and deliver features that directly grow inventory and revenue.

  • Lead high-stakes carrier partnerships, engaging C-level stakeholders to scope and deliver integrations that unlock new markets.

  • Challenge the status quo — question existing processes and raise the bar for how integrations are scoped, executed, and measured.

Workplace: Berlin & Hybrid; or Remote

We are a remote-first international company with team members spread around the world. We are looking to hire the best talent around the Globe, so wherever you are, feel free to reach out. If, however, you prefer working onsite/hybrid, our heart is in Berlin, one of the biggest and most vibrant tech hubs in Europe, and we are happy to assist with relocation.


  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on technical or API products. You've owned the full lifecycle of an integration product, not just supported it.

  • Deep technical fluency with APIs: comfortable reading documentation, working through data schema decisions with engineers, and spotting integration edge cases.

  • Experience scoping and delivering B2B integrations with external partners or enterprise clients, managing complexity across technical, commercial, and operational dimensions.

  • Fluent stakeholder communicator: translating complex technical concepts for executive stakeholders and engaging with equal depth on implementation detail with engineering teams.

  • Structured and delivery-oriented: you bring clarity to ambiguous scopes and drive execution with rigour.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with ground transportation data standards (e.g. GTFS, NeTEx) or experience in travel tech, mobility, or logistics.

  • Ready to lead (experience a plus): you may have already managed a small team of technical PMs or analysts. If not, you're excited to start. You know how to coach, unblock, and grow people while staying close to the work.

  • Exposure to high-load, high-availability platform environments.


What you can expect:

  • Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.

  • Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.

  • Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.

  • Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.

  • Work your way. Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.

title: Senior Product Manager, Billing Engine & Platforms Monetization
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Credit-based and consumption-based offerings are becoming central to how GitLab monetizes. The systems that meter, rate, and bill that consumption sit underneath all of it. You'll own the backend usage billing pipeline and its product direction while supporting the Monetization Platform and Infrastructure team as it modernizes the foundations underneath it.

When another GitLab team launches a credit-consuming capability, you'll help them make it billable across GitLab.com, self-managed, and GitLab Dedicated. This is a technical, systems-oriented product role: success means building a monetization platform other teams can launch on quickly and correctly, rather than shipping customer-facing UI.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product direction for metering, aggregation, and rating in GitLab's usage billing pipeline, including the Zuora and CustomersDot integrations that turn usage into invoiced revenue.
  • Make onboarding a new credit-consuming capability a repeatable process rather than a bespoke project each time.
  • Partner with product teams on what to instrument, how to meter and price usage across GitLab.com, self-managed, and GitLab Dedicated, and what it takes to be billable on launch day. Stay ahead of their roadmaps so billing doesn't delay launches.
  • Prioritize pipeline scalability, performance, and reliability as consumption grows, balancing those investments against new capability enablement.
  • Own billing defect detection and remediation so errors surface before they reach a customer's invoice and billing outcomes remain auditable.
  • Support the Monetization Platform and Infrastructure team by framing problems, explaining the value of platform investments, and prioritizing them against operational risk.
  • Define and track measures of billing accuracy, pipeline reliability, cost to serve per capability, and time to monetize so teams can make informed pricing decisions.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience owning the product direction of consumption- or usage-based billing systems.
  • Experience with Zuora or a comparable billing and revenue platform, and an understanding of how product and finance systems interact.
  • Experience with prepaid, commitment, or credit-drawdown pricing models (balances, reservations, overage, expiration) and the edge cases they create in billing and revenue.
  • Experience launching new products or pricing models while coordinating across engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance and go-to-market teams.
  • Ability to bring together teams you don't manage around work their launches depend on.
  • Experience defining problems for platform or backend teams whose users are often other teams.
  • Clear written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment; you'll use issues, epics, and direction pages to lead.
  • Familiarity with developer tooling, financial audit or revenue recognition, or an engineering background can help, but isn't required.
  • You use AI tools as part of how you work: prototyping, analysis, spec writing, and investigation.

About the team

In Monetization, we coordinate across engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance and go-to-market on new products and pricing models. Our remote, asynchronous work uses written issues, and epics to keep decisions visible.

Remote-Global

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An Overview about the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Lead-to-Opportunity (L2O) domain within our Salesforce and GTM technology ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of marketing operations, sales process, and technology owning the roadmap for how leads are captured, scored, routed, and converted into pipeline, and how our broader GTM tech stack supports that motion.

This is a foundational hire one of the first product managers on a team actively transforming from a reactive BSA model into a proactive, roadmap-driven product organization. You'll be both an individual contributor driving your own domain and a mentor helping BSAs grow into product manager roles. You'll have direct influence over how we shape the team's future operating model.

What You'll Do

Internal Product Roadmap Ownership

  • Define, own, and maintain the multi-quarter internal product roadmap for the Lead-to-Opportunity domain covering lead capture, enrichment, scoring, routing, conversion, opportunity and the broader GTM technology stack integrated with Salesforce
  • Translate business strategy from Marketing, Sales Development, RevOps, and GTM leadership into sequenced, prioritized system capabilities with clear outcomes and success metrics
  • Define the domain's strategic priorities each quarter and half, balancing net-new capability delivery, stabilization, and technical debt reduction with transparent trade-off frameworks
  • Drive quarterly planning ceremonies, partnering with Engineering Managers and BSAs to align capacity with roadmap commitments
  • Own domain-level documentation: process maps, current-vs-future state lead lifecycle flows, and decision logs that keep stakeholders and the team aligned on scope and ownership

Stakeholder Partnership & Requirements Translation

  • Serve as the primary product voice for all L2O and GTM Systems initiatives, partnering closely with Marketing, Marketing Operations, SDR/BDR leadership, Sales, and RevOps
  • Lead discovery, requirements workshops, and business process design sessions translating complex GTM and marketing operations requirements into actionable system specifications
  • Own the decision layer between "what the business needs" and "what engineering builds," resolving ambiguity with structured frameworks and documented decisions
  • Run structured stakeholder alignment sessions to surface trade-offs, build consensus, and drive open decisions to closure rather than letting them linger
  • Represent the domain in cross-team planning and leadership reviews able to explain technical constraints to business stakeholders and business context to engineers

Team Mentorship & Capability Building

  • Act as a product craft mentor and senior thought partner for the BSA team, actively upskilling analysts in product thinking, requirements structuring, acceptance criteria definition, and roadmap communication
  • Model and codify what "good" looks like reusable templates, rituals (backlog grooming, roadmap reviews), and a rubric BSAs can grow against
  • Give BSAs increasing ownership over pieces of the roadmap as they develop, with regular feedback and structured check-ins
  • Partner with leadership to evolve the team's operating model from project-execution-focused to product-thinking-led, raising the bar for how EntApps delivers business value

Program Strategy & Delivery Oversight

  • Lead initiatives end-to-end: discovery, requirements, prioritization, solution design review, UAT, launch, and post-launch measurement
  • Write and maintain clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and lead-flow and data-flow diagrams that engineering and admins can build against without ambiguity
  • Manage a healthy, well-groomed backlog intake requests from Marketing and Sales Development, triage by impact and effort, and defend prioritization decisions to stakeholders
  • Define success metrics per initiative (lead response time, routing accuracy, lead-to-opportunity conversion rate, data quality, SDR/BDR adoption) and report on outcomes, not just delivery
  • Identify and de-risk dependencies across adjacent domains campaign operations, data enrichment vendors, opportunity handoff to sales before they block delivery
  • Own UAT strategy and acceptance criteria in collaboration with BSAs, ensuring system changes meet business requirements before production release

Systems Architecture Collaboration

  • Partner with Enterprise Architects and Engineering Managers on Salesforce and MarTech integration design marketing automation platform to Salesforce sync, data enrichment pipelines, lead scoring and routing engines, ensuring choices hold up to governance, scale, and future roadmap needs
  • Bring informed opinions on GTM platform architecture trade-offs based on deep domain knowledge
  • Stay current on platform roadmaps for Salesforce Sales Cloud and connected MarTech tools, identifying opportunities to leverage native capabilities before custom builds
  • Maintain domain-level R&R clarity, who owns what across US/India technical managers, BSAs, and adjacent pods and update as team and scope evolve
  • Ability to engage deeply with engineering and architecture teams on API design, data modeling, and integration patterns.

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years in Salesforce product management, business systems analysis, or Marketing/Revenue Operations technology roles, with demonstrated growth into product ownership
  • Strong working knowledge of Lead-to-Opportunity processes; lead capture, scoring, routing, and conversion and how they connect marketing execution to sales pipeline
  • Hands-on familiarity with the GTM technology stack: Salesforce Sales Cloud plus marketing automation platforms (Marketo, HubSpot, or Pardot), lead scoring and routing tools, and data enrichment or intent providers
  • Good Understanding of quoting process
  • Demonstrated ability to own and communicate multi-quarter internal product roadmaps to senior business and technology stakeholders
  • Proven experience leading initiatives end-to-end with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities, especially across Marketing and Sales
  • Sufficient technical fluency to engage meaningfully with engineering on API design, data model decisions, and integration trade-offs — without needing to write code
  • Experience mentoring or upskilling analysts and BSAs, you enjoy developing people, not just managing tickets
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to represent technical trade-offs to non-technical executives and translate business asks into clear technical requirements
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving structure where none exists
  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows, data governance and compliance for lead data, or prior people-management experience

About the Team

You'll be one of the first product managers on a team actively transforming from a reactive BSA function into a proactive, roadmap-driven product organization. The Lead-to-Opportunity domain sits at the top of GitLab's revenue funnel; the quality of data, routing, and conversion here affects every downstream system and every seller. Getting this right is not an IT problem; it's a revenue problem. You'll have direct influence over how we shape the team's future operating model and how the next generation of BSAs grows into product managers.

title: Senior Program Manager, Workplace Operations
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community you will join:

The Lead Program Manager, Workplace Operations is responsible for leading and scaling programs that span the Workplace Operations organization. This role operates across functions and geographies, owning programs end-to-end while building the structure, processes, and tools that enable the broader team to operate consistently and at scale.

Currently, the Workplace Operations team is made up of multiple teams delivering at a high bar across a global office footprint, each with its own processes, tools, vendors, and rhythms. This role exists to look across all of it: to understand how the work actually gets done today, find where effort is duplicated or handoffs break down, and design a more connected and automated way of operating. It is equal parts program delivery and operational modernization.

The difference you will make:

This is a cross-functional role that requires strong program management fundamentals, independent judgment, and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority. You will build a clear picture of how Workplace Ops teams work today, surface the gaps and opportunities that get in the way of efficiency and alignment, and turn that into a strategic and scalable roadmap: what we should build in-house, what is better delivered through vendors, and most importantly what can be automated with AI.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, skilled at building clarity and alignment, curious about how emerging technology changes operational work, and motivated by improving how teams operate and deliver for employees globally.

A typical day:

  • Own and manage a portfolio of cross-functional programs with global scope, driving delivery from inception through ongoing operation and continuous improvement
  • Develop and maintain program-level policies, processes, playbooks, and operating standards that enable the Workplace Ops team to deliver consistently across regions and functions
  • Lead cross-functional workstreams in partnership with teams across the organization, ensuring Workplace Ops priorities are clearly represented, aligned, and delivered
  • Identify gaps in current program offerings and proactively develop solutions, often without an established playbook
  • Build and scale operational tooling, workflows, and internal resources that improve team effectiveness and the consistency of the employee-facing experience
  • Develop measurement frameworks and synthesize data and feedback to assess program performance, identify improvement opportunities, and inform strategic decisions
  • Support the team’s internal operating model by contributing to goal-setting, roadmap development, and team ways of working
  • Manage vendor relationships and provide direction where relevant to program delivery, ensuring alignment to Airbnb standards
  • Serve as a thought partner to Workplace Ops leadership on organizational priorities, team capacity, and program strategy
  • Communicate effectively across all levels of the organization, translating complex operational topics into clear guidance and actionable recommendations

Driving efficiency, alignment, and digital transformation:

A core pillar of this role is improving how Workplace Ops teams work, not only delivering the programs they run today. In this part of the job, you will:

  • Map how Workplace Ops teams operate today — processes, tools, systems, vendors, and handoffs — and build a shared, evidence-based view of the current state across functions and regions
  • Identify gaps, duplication, manual effort, and friction points where teams could run more efficiently, and size the opportunity so investment decisions are grounded in data
  • Create alignment and synergy across teams that operate independently today, consolidating overlapping workflows and standardizing where standardization helps, while preserving local flexibility where it matters
  • Develop clear build / buy / automate recommendations: what capability we should build in house, what is better delivered through vendors and managed service partners, and what should be automated
  • Lead the identification and adoption of AI-enabled workflows — from intake, triage, and routing to reporting, knowledge management, and employee self-service — and turn promising ideas into scoped, measurable pilots
  • Partner with IT, Technology, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Privacy, and Security to evaluate tools and platforms, define requirements, and ensure new solutions meet Airbnb standards for data handling, security, and responsible AI use
  • Build the business case for change, including cost, effort, risk, and expected efficiency gains, and present recommendations to Workplace Ops and cross-functional leadership
  • Lead change management and enablement for new processes and tools — training, documentation, and adoption tracking — so improvements stick and teams feel supported through the transition
  • Define success metrics for transformation work (cycle time, cost per transaction, manual hours saved, employee satisfaction) and report on realized impact over time

Your expertise:

  • 12-15+ years of experience in program management, workplace operations, or a closely related field
  • Practical experience applying AI and automation to operational work — identifying high-value use cases, scoping pilots, and scaling what works
  • Demonstrated track record of independently owning and delivering multiple complex, cross-functional programs simultaneously
  • Previous people management experience preferred
  • Experience managing programs with global reach, including stakeholder alignment across functions, regions, and seniority levels
  • Experience assessing how existing teams operate and translating that assessment into an actionable roadmap of process, tooling, and automation improvements
  • Strong systems-thinking and process-design skills; ability to build structure and clarity in fast-moving, ambiguous environments
  • Experience making and defending build / buy / outsource decisions, including vendor evaluation, scoping, and ongoing performance management
  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority across teams and organizational levels
  • Experience developing policies, playbooks, and operational tooling for distributed teams
  • Experience leading change management for new ways of working, including enablement and adoption
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable using data to measure program performance, build a business case, and drive decisions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging to diverse audiences
  • Proficiency with program and project management tools (e.g., Airtable, JIRA, or equivalent), and comfort with workflow automation and integration platforms
  • Customer service orientation and a commitment to delivering a high-quality employee experience
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy in a high-visibility environment with senior stakeholders

Your Location:

This position needs to be based in the San Francisco office as required by the business needs for the role.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range
$156,000—$193,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Product Manager, Browser Extension
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX | London, UK | Lisbon, Portugal

About the Department

The Product Management team at Cloudflare steers the strategy, roadmap, and execution that powers a faster, more secure internet. As part of the Zero Trust Security organization, our mission is to redefine corporate networking and security. We build solutions that protect users, devices, and data globally without sacrificing performance, replacing legacy architectures with our modern, identity-aware global network.

About the role

You will own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Cloudflare One Browser Extension. You will also work alongside the Digital Experience Monitoring (DEX) and WARP Client teams, heavily influencing their direction and owning selected initiatives as customer needs and business priorities evolve.

This role combines focused ownership with range. You will take an emerging product from early adoption to a scaled enterprise capability, while moving across adjacent Cloudflare One priorities where strong product leadership is needed. More than narrow domain expertise, success requires exceptional problem solving, sound judgment, and the ability to quickly understand and lead in new technical areas. This work will help advance Cloudflare’s long-term position in SASE and SSE.

This is a high-judgment role. Success requires navigating conflicting customer signals, making trade-offs with incomplete information, and building trust across engineering and sales teams—work that demands human context and accountability and cannot be delegated to automation.

Responsibilities

  • Own Browser Extension: Set the strategy, roadmap, and execution plan for Cloudflare One Browser Extension. Grow it into a trusted enterprise product that addresses meaningful browser security and visibility needs, integrates naturally with Cloudflare One, and earns sustained customer adoption.
  • Shape the Enterprise Client and Digital Experience: Work alongside the WARP Client and DEX teams to improve how customers deploy, operate, and troubleshoot Cloudflare One. Influence product direction, connect customer needs across the browser, device, and network, and own selected initiatives when dedicated leadership will accelerate an important outcome.
  • Drive Product Strategy: Connect browser, device, and network capabilities into a coherent Cloudflare One experience. Set clear priorities across products at different stages of maturity and adjust ownership as new opportunities emerge.
  • Talk to Customers: Work directly with enterprise security, networking, and IT teams to understand their most important problems. Translate those needs into focused product decisions without overfitting to individual customer requests.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Support, and adjacent product teams to deliver high-impact products from concept to global launch.
  • Data-Informed Decision Making: Analyze product usage, reliability, support signals, market trends, and competitive capabilities to identify opportunities, make trade-offs, and measure customer outcomes.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Demonstrated Product Leadership: Experience managing technically complex B2B products through the full product lifecycle, with a record of finding the right problem, setting a clear direction, and shipping products customers value.
  • AI Fluency: Demonstrated experience using AI assistants, coding tools, and agentic workflows to accelerate product work. You should be comfortable in an AI-native environment where tools like OpenCode are standard infrastructure, not optional perks.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Proven track record of quickly understanding unfamiliar problem spaces, turning ambiguous technical challenges into clear plans, and prioritizing the work that will have the greatest impact.

  • You are deep enough on the technology to earn a room's trust. title: Technical Program Manager, AI Tooling
region: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We're looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager to build and run the program operating system for Figma's growing Internal AI Tooling portfolio. Reporting into the CIO PMO and embedded within the team driving this work, you'll partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to translate an emerging roadmap into coordinated, secure, and scalable capabilities used across Figma — bringing together Engineering, Security, Legal, Procurement, Data Engineering, Business Systems, IT, Enablement, and business teams.

You'll create clarity across this system by establishing lightweight planning and governance, aligning teams around shared milestones and decisions, and ensuring initiatives move from intake through release and operational handoff with clear ownership and measurable outcomes — shaping not only what gets delivered, but also how Figma evaluates, builds, releases, and operates internal AI capabilities as the portfolio grows.

The ideal candidate can bring structure to an ambiguous, fast-moving environment without introducing unnecessary process, and can lead complex work through influence rather than direct authority.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Translate the Product Manager's roadmap and prioritized outcomes into integrated program plans, milestones, release schedules, decision points, and clear ownership
  • Manage execution of the Internal AI Tooling roadmap across technical teams and business stakeholders
  • Operationalize a transparent intake and routing process so requests have a defined problem, expected business outcome, delivery path, risk profile, and accountable owner before work begins
  • Establish and facilitate lightweight planning and execution cadences, including program reviews, dependency reviews, decision forums, release-readiness reviews, and stakeholder updates
  • Maintain an integrated view of dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, and decisions, driving timely resolution or escalation when work is blocked
  • Coordinate security reviews, legal and procurement milestones, data dependencies, vendor commitments, and business-system integrations so these workstreams are engaged at the appropriate stage of delivery
  • Ensure releases have appropriate acceptance criteria, operational ownership, support processes, runbooks, escalation paths, and feedback loops before handoff
  • Partner with Product and stakeholders to define measurable outcomes and provide clear reporting on delivery health, adoption readiness, operational performance, and realized impact

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years of technical program management, or technical delivery experience in a cloud, SaaS, enterprise-technology, or internal-tools environment
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex programs across Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Data, Business Systems, Operations, and business stakeholders
  • A track record of translating product roadmaps into integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, decision points, release schedules, and measurable outcomes while maintaining clear ownership boundaries between Product, Program, and Engineering
  • Technical fluency with enterprise systems, APIs, integrations, data flows, platform dependencies, identity and access, and software-delivery lifecycles. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be able to engage credibly in technical planning and tradeoff conversations
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, with the ability to establish lightweight governance, present concise decisions and risks, and create accountability without relying on direct authority

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

  • Direct experience delivering internal AI tooling, platform, or product programs in a rapidly evolving technology environment
  • Experience with responsible AI, model governance, security, privacy, compliance, or AI risk-management frameworks
  • Familiarity with enterprise SaaS, middleware, low-code or no-code automation, identity platforms, data platforms, vendor evaluation, or procurement processes

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Principal Product Manager for the Channels email team.

About the job

We’re hiring a Principal Product Manager to own and lead strategic email data plane integrations strategy. You’ll navigate complex infrastructure challenges with demonstrable technical acumen while actively partnering with key external and internal partners. By transforming ambiguity into resilient, scalable systems, you’ll protect vital revenue streams and lay the groundwork for the future growth. Join us to define the next chapter of email at Twilio.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be a subject matter expert on email, cross-channel and partner integrations, resolving complex product issues that arise.
  • Use financial and engineering context to contextualize total opportunity size (and business impact/ROI) of proposed product improvements
  • Develop and lead the multi-year product roadmap for your domain, driving development from concept through launch and ongoing maturity
  • Make synthesized recommendations on priorities by opportunity and timing
  • Partner with GTM stakeholders to ensure successful and measurable delivery of commitments
  • Lead product requirements, program milestones, and launch planning, particularly when it comes to transitioning customers off of old products and APIs in favor of modernized versions.
  • Document ideas and research quickly for review and iteration from your teams, to support our remote-first environment
  • Collaborate with adjacent product managers

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 10+ years experience in product management, with 5+ years in the email domain. You are known as an expert, with a proven track record of outcomes, and shaping the strategy of communication products.
  • Proven ability to work backwards from customer needs, crystallizing problems that translate into impactful product decisions.
  • Strong understanding of how B2B and large enterprises operate, including sales cycles and organizational dynamics.
  • Strong understanding of Amazon Web Services Cloud services. Understanding of Microsoft Azure Cloud services is also strongly desired.
  • Experience in APIs or platform products, including designing for reliability, scale, and developer usability.
  • Soft Skills: Highly collaborative and excel in building cross-functional relationships in remote, global teams; able to mentor, inspire, and set vision for high-impact initiatives



Location

This role will be remote in the United States,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project, customer, partner or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $171,120.00 – $213,900.00
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area) $181,200.00 – $226,500.00
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $201,280.00 – $251,600.00
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information (required for ALL US jobs)

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 10/25/2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Principal Product Manager, AI Software Factory

As Principal Product Manager, Software Factory, you’ll define and bring together GitLab’s end-to-end software creation experience, from planning and specification through coding, review, and verification. You’ll connect capabilities across GitLab Duo Agent Platform and the wider GitLab product so customers have a cohesive and delightful experience. This is a senior, high-visibility role for a product leader who can shape product direction, work across organizational boundaries, and clearly present recommendations to executive leaders.

What you’ll do

  • Define the product vision and strategy for GitLab’s end-to-end software factory experience.
  • Bring together planning, specification, coding, review, and verification workflows into a cohesive product experience.
  • Partner with product, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams across GitLab to align priorities and execution.
  • Identify gaps, dependencies, and opportunities across GitLab Duo Agent Platform and related areas of the GitLab product.
  • Use strong product and design judgment to make complex workflows clear and useful for customers.
  • Build support for product decisions through clear communication, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Present product direction, tradeoffs, and recommendations to senior and executive leaders.
  • Help shape how GitLab brings its software factory vision to market.

What you’ll bring

  • Product management experience at principal scope, leading complex products or experiences across multiple teams.
  • A strong understanding of the end-to-end software development workflow, from planning through verification.
  • Experience with artificial intelligence products, developer tools, DevSecOps platforms, or related technical products.
  • Technical judgment that supports effective collaboration with engineering teams and informed product decisions.
  • Strong product design and user experience instincts, including the ability to connect separate capabilities into a coherent experience.
  • Experience influencing across functions, resolving competing priorities, and moving work forward without relying on direct authority.
  • Clear communication and presentation skills, including experience working with senior and executive leaders.
  • An ownership mindset and the ability to make progress in a fast-changing product area with some ambiguity.

This role will work across GitLab to connect the teams building the future of our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll partner closely with the GitLab Duo Agent Platform organization and with product areas that own key parts of the software development workflow. The team’s central challenge is to turn work delivered across several groups into one clear, end-to-end experience for customers while supporting GitLab’s mission to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. title: Technical Program Manager, Life Sciences
region: San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Scientists use Claude across the life sciences, from drug discovery and research biology to clinical development and manufacturing. To support that work, Anthropic introduced the Life Sciences Verification Program (LSVP), which gives verified life science professionals access to Claude with a refined set of safeguards that is more permissive for biology-related work. The program is in beta.We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to own the program of work that expands that access and helps scale it with safety in mind.

Each expansion depends on many teams at once and no single team owns the path end to end. You'll become the single owner of that program, the person who knows what each expansion requires, where every workstream stands, what it is waiting on, and who needs to decide. This is a cross-org execution role, not a research role, and it does not require a life sciences background. LSVP is the starting point, and the scope will grow alongside Anthropic's broader work in the life sciences. Over time, more of the life sciences community can get verified access, and each new expansion takes less bespoke effort than the last.

Responsibilities

  • Own the program for expanding access to Anthropic's life sciences verification programs: scoping, sequencing, dependencies, and tradeoffs across safeguards, platform, and product engineering teams
  • Scope and drive the cross-org engineering work that each expansion requires, from new plan and account types to new platforms
  • Partner with the product manager to turn program goals into a sequenced plan with clear owners and dates
  • Drive clarity on data access, retention, and review requirements, and on the changes they require across safeguards, access, and provisioning
  • Drive user experience scoping across the Claude product surfaces where the program is available
  • Find and remove the technical blockers that keep eligible organizations from accessing life sciences capabilities
  • Establish the operating rhythm: a single view of workstreams, owners, dependencies, risks, and status, with planning, escalation paths, and launch coordination across orgs
  • Convert recurring efforts into documented, repeatable processes so that each new expansion requires less bespoke coordination

You may be a good fit if you

  • Have several years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional programs
  • Have experience coordinating across multiple engineering teams and organizations simultaneously, including safeguards, platform, and product partners
  • Can engage meaningfully with the engineers doing the work, from platform and access systems to product surfaces
  • Are highly organized and can manage multiple parallel workstreams effectively across distributed teams
  • Thrive in unstructured environments with a knack for bringing order to chaos and creating clarity in ambiguous situations
  • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority
  • Have worked on cloud or platform programs (preferred but not required)
  • Do not need a life sciences background. This is not a research role, and no life sciences experience is required
  • Are passionate about Anthropic's mission and interested in the challenges of bringing AI capabilities to the life sciences community safely and reliably

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$290,000—$365,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Staff Product Manager - Email Growth
description:
About Us

HighLevel is an AI-powered, all-in-one white-label sales & marketing platform that empowers agencies, entrepreneurs, and businesses to elevate their digital presence and drive growth. We are proud to support a global and growing community of over 2 million businesses, including agencies, consultants, and businesses of all sizes and industries. HighLevel empowers users with all the tools needed to capture, nurture, and close new leads into repeat customers. HighLevel processes over 4 billion API hits and handles more than 2.5 billion message events every day. Our platform manages over 470 terabytes of data distributed across five databases, operates with a network of over 250 microservices, and supports over 1 million hostnames.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, we operate in a global, remote-first environment. We are building more than software; we are building a global community rooted in creativity, collaboration, and impact. We take pride in cultivating a culture where innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated, and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Our platform powers over 1.5 billion messages, helps generate over 200 million leads, and facilitates over 20 million conversations for the more than 2 million businesses we serve each month. Behind those numbers are real people growing their companies, connecting with customers, and making their mark — and we get to help make that happen.

Role Overview

HighLevel is looking for a Staff Product Manager - Growth to drive activation, feature adoption, product-led expansion, and retention across the entire Email Charter. In this role, you will be responsible for turning new and existing agencies into active email power users by optimizing onboarding funnels, designing viral product-led growth (PLG) mechanics, running continuous experimentation programs, and directly linking email feature adoption to customer lifecycle value and ARR.

Key Responsibilities

1. Optimize Activation & Onboarding Funnels
Design frictionless onboarding journeys that accelerate time-to-value for agencies and sub-accounts configuring email templates, sending campaigns, and launching sequences.

2. Drive Product-Led Growth (PLG) & Viral Expansion
Implement PLG loops, feature discovery nudges, template sharing ecosystems, and in-app monetization/upsell prompts to expand email usage across sub-accounts.

3. Build & Scale Experimentation Pipeline
Establish a high-velocity A/B testing framework covering onboarding flows, feature paywalls, pricing tiers, and campaign setup wizards to continuously improve conversion rates.

4. Track Product Analytics & Campaign ROI
Define and monitor core activation funnels, usage decay metrics, and feature retention cohorts, demonstrating a clear correlation between email usage and platform retention.

5. Execute Cross-Functional Growth Strategy
Partner closely with Product Marketing, Growth Engineering, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to deploy targeted growth campaigns and adoption initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

  • Funnel Analysis: Map and analyze the end-to-end user journey for Email Marketing, identifying key friction points and drop-off stages in onboarding.

  • Experimentation Cadence: Establish a structured experimentation backlog and launch initial A/B tests on onboarding and feature discovery flows.

  • North Star Alignment: Define clear growth metrics (e.g., Activation Rate, Campaign Creation Velocity) and align stakeholders.

First 12 Months

  • Activation Lift: Achieve measurable, double-digit increases in new user email activation rates within their first 14 days.

  • PLG Expansion: Successfully launch template-sharing and feature-discovery growth loops that drive viral adoption across sub-accounts.

  • Retention Impact: Demonstrate a direct positive impact on sub-account retention and platform lifetime value (LTV) driven by email feature engagement.

Requirements

  • Experience: 8+ years of Product Management experience with a dedicated focus on Growth, PLG, funnel optimization, or monetization in B2B SaaS platforms.

  • Experimentation Mastery: Proven track record of designing and executing high-velocity A/B and multivariate testing programs that yield statistically significant growth.

  • Analytics Expertise: Deep mastery of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Heap, etc.), cohort analysis, funnel tracking, and SQL/data visualization.

  • Growth Instincts: Strong product intuition paired with a highly analytical, hypotheses-driven operational methodology.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Ability to lead matrixed growth teams across engineering, marketing, design, and analytics.

Nice-to-Have

  • MarTech Growth: Prior experience driving growth or product-led adoption within marketing automation, CRM, or agency management platforms.

  • Pricing & Packaging: Experience optimizing pricing tiers, feature gating, or usage-based monetization models.

title: Technical Program Manager, People Innovation Labs
description:
About the Team

People Innovation Labs is a product, design, and engineering team embedded in the People organization. We build AI-powered products that improve how OpenAI finds and supports exceptional talent and helps employees do their best work.

Our work spans recruiting, HR, learning, performance, culture, and company-wide knowledge. We build new products from the ground up and work closely with teams across OpenAI to rethink existing workflows using our latest models.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead execution across a portfolio of complex, cross-functional initiatives.

You’ll partner closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and teams across the People organization to turn product strategy into clear, coordinated execution. You’ll establish the plans and operating structures needed to move work forward, align technical and operational teams, drive decisions, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure stakeholders are prepared for launches.

Because we build new products from the ground up, the work does not end when a product launches. You’ll own ongoing engagement with users, including onboarding, training, hands-on support, and creating clear ways for people to share feedback. You’ll develop a deep understanding of how our products fit into users’ day-to-day work, what is working, and where they are struggling. You’ll bring those insights back to product, design, and engineering so the team can iterate quickly toward product-market fit.

You’ll also help keep the team aligned with its broader objectives. You’ll maintain a clear view of priorities, progress, dependencies, risks, and outcomes across the portfolio and provide clear updates and recommendations to team and company leadership.

In this role, you will:

  • Independently lead complex, high-priority technical programs from early planning through launch, adoption, and ongoing iteration.

  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to translate strategy and team objectives into clear, executable plans.

  • Establish program structures, decision-making forums, operating cadences, and accountability across multiple teams.

  • Align product, design, engineering, data, operations, and other stakeholders around priorities, responsibilities, and delivery plans.

  • Partner closely with engineering leads to manage technical dependencies, sequencing, delivery risks, and launch readiness.

  • Identify gaps in strategy or execution, develop recommendations, and drive the decisions needed to move work forward.

  • Anticipate risks and blockers, clarify tradeoffs, resolve disagreements, and escalate decisions when needed.

  • Own communication, enablement, change management, and rollout strategies for new products and workflows.

  • Lead post-launch user engagement through onboarding, training, office hours, hands-on support, and other programs that drive adoption.

  • Build trusted relationships with users and create an environment where they provide frequent, candid feedback.

  • Observe how products fit into real workflows and identify points of confusion, friction, or unmet need.

  • Combine user feedback, usage data, and operational signals to understand what is working and what needs to change.

  • Translate user insights into clear themes and actionable recommendations for product, design, and engineering.

  • Create tight feedback loops that help the team test assumptions, learn quickly, and iterate toward product-market fit.

  • Define and track program health, adoption, user sentiment, and operational outcomes.

  • Maintain visibility into priorities, progress, dependencies, and risks across the team’s portfolio.

  • Prepare clear, decision-oriented updates and recommendations for senior leadership.

  • Improve the team’s planning and execution practices while keeping processes lightweight.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 7+ years of experience in technical program management, product operations, or a similar role leading complex software initiatives.

  • Have independently led multiple high-impact programs involving several technical and business teams.

  • Have helped take new software products from early planning through launch, adoption, and rapid iteration toward product-market fit.

  • Are energized by working directly with users and willing to provide hands-on support while a product is still new.

  • Know how to build trust with users, ask good questions, and get candid feedback about what is and is not working.

  • Can identify patterns across qualitative feedback, usage data, and operational signals and turn them into actionable recommendations.

  • Have strong technical fluency and can partner with engineers on architecture, integrations, data dependencies, security, reliability, and delivery tradeoffs.

  • Have led significant operational or organizational change alongside technical product delivery.

  • Can influence senior leaders, drive difficult decisions, and build alignment across teams with competing priorities.

  • Identify and address strategic or execution gaps without waiting for detailed direction.

  • Communicate clearly and directly across technical teams, operational partners, users, and executives.

  • Can move comfortably between organizational strategy and detailed, hands-on execution

  • Bring structure to fast-moving work without adding unnecessary process.

  • Are curious about how AI can change the way organizations operate and how people work.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

Software is increasingly built by machines and directed by people. When agentic coding tools accelerate without context, governance, and lifecycle control, teams get speed with chaos. GitLab enables speed with control: customers deploy agents across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) with the orchestration, context, security, and governance to ship trusted software at scale.

The same principles show up in how we work. We build a culture of excellence around Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset, and Customer Outcomes, and we treat AI as a core productivity multiplier. An overview of this role

As Principal Program Manager, Go-To-Market, you own two equal pillars of go-to-market execution for Product & Technical Marketing (PTM). First, you are the strategic and hands-on architect behind GitLab's high-stakes minor and major launches, redesigning the launch operating model with AI agents at its core so customers discover, adopt, and experience GitLab with precision.

Second, you run program management on key initiatives that span Product Management and Product Design through Growth Marketing, Comms and Social, and Field Enablement, wherever those motions depend on PTM. PTM team is responsible for product and solutions marketing, technical writing and documentation, developer advocacy, and globalization, and acts as the glue between these functions across a variety of go-to-market initiatives.

You are AI-first by default. When programs still run on many manual steps, you convert that work into team-wide AI workflows, either by shipping the automations yourself or by partnering with the AI Transformation Owner (ATO) for the marketing organization to drive shared skills, adoption, and governance. You are not a reactive deadline chaser. You drive solutions with stakeholders as dates approach, design decision stages so tradeoffs land early, and redesign stages and workflows when product roadmap, growth priorities, or major launch decisions change. You create clarity in ambiguity: frame the problem, present options and tradeoffs, name owners, and optimize for decision velocity.

In your first year, you institutionalize a dual operating system: a scalable launch framework for 15+ minor and major launches per year, and a portfolio program practice that maps dependencies from Product and Design through PTM into Growth, Comms, and Field. You ship production agent workflows that cut manual coordination, establish benchmarks for quality, and make go-to-market program management achieve relevance in the AI era, and become a trusted partner across the organization.

Reporting to the VP of Product & Technical Marketing, you operate with significant executive visibility and autonomy. You measure success by what lands for customers and the business: pipeline where it matters, and brand and community impact where business requires it, not by activity volume alone.

  • Keep field enablement on track when they depend on messaging and sales assets
  • Design decision points early so blockers show up before the deadline
  • Scope launches for pipeline and for post-launch adoption when agentic products are involved
  • Build AI workflows that draft briefs, synthesize status, and cut manual program steps
  • Rebuild stages and calendars when roadmap, growth priorities, or launch plans change
  • Run retrospectives that improve the system, and remove process as often as you add it

What you'll do

  • Give leadership the context to decide: risks, options, and a recommendation, not status theater
  • Align go-to-market functions when work streams collide or compete for the same people
  • Codify how programs run so each cycle starts sharper than the last
  • Put quality in the path of the work, then confirm market-facing pieces landed as intended
  • Turn recurring coordination into shared AI workflows the team can run without you in the loop
  • Partner with Marketing's ATO when a workflow needs department-wide adoption or guardrails
  • Escalate early with a clear ask when a call sits above the working team
  • Protect focus with smaller core teams, fewer standing meetings, more working sessions
  • Close the loop on results with the data team, then feed what you learn into the next cycle

What you'll bring

  • Program management for go-to-market across the high-tech industry, with first-hand experience with complex, multi-stakeholder and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Experience building and scaling how programs run in large, distributed orgs, with clear results
  • Hands-on work with AI agents and automations that real teams used in production
  • A track record of turning manual work into AI workflows and helping others adopt them
  • Comfort standing up launch and program frameworks without adding busywork
  • Strong grasp of how product releases and how they impact go-to-market teams
  • Bias to action for priorities: defining risks and clear options for path forward
  • Habit of measuring success by pipeline, adoption, or consumption, not activity counts
  • Ability to run several high-stakes workstreams at once without dropping quality or trust
  • Clear writing and speaking with executives; gets decisions made across competing priorities
  • Influence without direct authority, including with senior leaders
  • Fluency with project tools with AI automation on top, and the ability to use GitLab
  • Ability to travel if needed and comply with the company's travel policy

About the team

Product & Technical Marketing at GitLab is the engine behind how GitLab positions, launches, documents, and evangelizes its value proposition for enterprises worldwide. We connect GitLab's product capabilities to customers and prospects across technical personas and executive buyers, and we partner closely with Product Management, Product Design, Growth Marketing, Comms and Social, Field Enablement, Sales, and the broader go-to-market organization so what we build lands in market with clarity, impact, and relevance. We operate as one marketing organization with clear roles: PTM carries the message; Growth activates demand; Comms amplifies narrative; work moves when handoffs are explicit.

You serve as the senior operational and program spine inside Product & Technical Marketing. An overview of this role

GitLab is building the most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform, and this role will help shape how teams move from planning to code in an AI-native software development lifecycle.

As Senior Product Manager, Source Code, you'll shape how planning and managing source code will evolve in an AI-native software development lifecycle. This role is focused on bringing planning and code closer together, so teams can move from requirements and specifications to commits, merge requests, and customer value with speed and quality.

This area is evolving quickly. We're exploring how AI agents can use specifications, context, and human feedback to build the right thing, not just build the thing right. You'll define new product experiences for spec-driven, human-in-the loop development: how the link between planning intent and the code that implements it gets created, stays accurate as both change, and gets used at review time. The hard part is that this link decays. Code moves, specs might not follow, you will define how to make that connection self-maintaining.

This is an ambiguous, high-impact opportunity for a product manager who has strong software development lifecycle knowledge, is comfortable working with technical teams, and wants to help create something new in DevSecOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and drive product strategy for experiences that connect planning, source code management, and AI-assisted development.
  • Shape workflows where teams and agents move between intent and code in both directions, so a specification can be traced to the merges that implement it and a diff can be read and reviewed against the intent behind it.
  • Work with engineering, design, and other product teams to build product experiences that support human-in-the-loop and autonomous development workflows.
  • Partner with teams working on demos and prototypes, including near-term work around spec-driven planning and autonomous development modes, including which decisions stay with a human and why.
  • Use customer insights, product usage data, and market context to identify opportunities that can deliver customer value quickly.
  • Help teams ship fast with quality, balancing near-term execution with longer-term product direction.
  • Explore how planning can better account for reviewing code, reviewing test cases, and validating that work produced by agents matches the intended outcome.
  • Collaborate across Plan, Source Code Management, Code Review, and AI product areas to reduce friction across the software development lifecycle.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience as a product manager working on developer tools, DevOps tools, source code management, planning tools, AI-native products, or related software development lifecycle products.
  • Direct, hands-on experience with the source code lifecycle, including branches, merge requests, code review, CI/CD, and releases, whether as a product manager or as an engineer, along with a strong understanding of how software moves from ideas and requirements through planning, coding, review, testing, and delivery.
  • Experience working with technical product areas and engineering teams, with enough technical depth to understand developer workflows and tradeoffs.
  • A data-forward approach to product management, including experience using data to identify customer impact and guide prioritization.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous spaces where there may not yet be a clear market pattern or established product category.
  • Experience building or shipping with AI tools and agents, not just using them, and a point of view of your own on where AI helps and where it does not across the software development lifecycle.
  • Ability to think creatively about how AI changes the software development lifecycle and how product experiences should adapt.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, especially in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.
  • A bias toward action and the ability to help teams ship meaningful customer value quickly.
