title: Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure Strategy & Delivery Operations
description:
About the Team

OpenAI's Industrial Compute organization is building the world's most advanced AI infrastructure ecosystem. In partnership with leading cloud providers, hardware manufacturers, utilities, construction partners, and internal engineering organizations, we are delivering hyperscale AI campuses that power the next generation of frontier AI models.

Infrastructure Delivery Operations sits at the center of this effort. Our team develops the operating model that connects infrastructure strategy, supply planning, manufacturing operations, and delivery into a single, integrated system that enables OpenAI to deploy AI infrastructure predictably at scale.

We partner across Hardware Engineering, Network Engineering, Capacity Delivery, Hardware Operations, Security, Finance, Strategic Sourcing, and external infrastructure partners to create a single, integrated view of program health. Through governance, operational analytics, executive reporting, and scalable operating mechanisms, we enable leaders to proactively manage risk, optimize capacity, and deliver infrastructure predictably at Industrial Compute speed.

About the Role

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure Delivery Operations to drive integrated strategy and delivery across OpenAI's rapidly expanding AI infrastructure portfolio.

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure strategy, New Product Introduction (NPI), supply planning, manufacturing operations, and infrastructure delivery. You will lead highly cross-functional programs spanning engineering, supply planning, manufacturing, logistics, construction, commissioning, and operations, ensuring technical and operational dependencies remain synchronized from planning through production readiness.

Beyond driving program execution, you will leverage operational insights to improve capacity planning, infrastructure strategy, and deployment readiness. You will also help operationalize new technologies and suppliers by partnering with Engineering, Strategic Sourcing, and Supply Chain to successfully transition new infrastructure platforms into production.

Success in this role requires exceptional program management, systems thinking, executive communication, and the ability to translate complex technical and operational information into clear decisions and scalable operating mechanisms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale AI infrastructure programs from early planning through operational handoff.

  • Analyze infrastructure capacity, manufacturing capability, and supply availability to develop strategic recommendations that inform supply planning, deployment sequencing, and infrastructure investment decisions.

  • Partner with Engineering, Strategic Sourcing, and Supply Chain to operationalize New Product Introduction (NPI), ensuring new technologies, suppliers, and infrastructure platforms transition successfully into production and deployment.

  • Develop and maintain integrated program plans that align engineering, manufacturing, logistics, construction, commissioning, and operations into a single source of truth.

  • Proactively manage dependencies, critical path, execution risks, and recovery plans across internal teams and external infrastructure partners.

  • Partner with Strategic Sourcing, Supply Chain, suppliers, and manufacturing partners to assess production readiness, manufacturing performance, logistics, and deployment readiness while proactively identifying operational risks.

  • Design governance models, operating mechanisms, dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting that improve visibility, predictability, and data-driven decision making.

  • Translate complex technical, operational, and business challenges into concise executive communications, strategic recommendations, and actionable decisions.

  • Continuously improve Infrastructure Delivery Operations' operating model, planning processes, and delivery methodologies to support OpenAI's rapidly expanding infrastructure portfolio.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years leading complex technical programs, infrastructure delivery initiatives, or large-scale operational programs.

  • Experience leading highly cross-functional programs spanning engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, construction, infrastructure operations, or New Product Introduction (NPI).

  • Strong understanding of integrated program management, dependency management, critical-path planning, and risk mitigation.

  • Working knowledge of electrical and mechanical infrastructure systems, including critical power and cooling equipment commonly deployed within hyperscale data centers (e.g., switchgear, transformers, generators, UPS systems, cooling systems, and related infrastructure).

  • Experience supporting supply planning, manufacturing operations, supply chain operations, or deployment planning for complex infrastructure programs.

  • Experience developing executive dashboards, governance mechanisms, operational KPIs, forecasting models, and scalable program management frameworks.

  • Strong systems-thinking and analytical skills with the ability to connect technical, operational, manufacturing, and business dependencies across complex infrastructure programs.

  • Experience influencing senior technical and business stakeholders without direct organizational authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated experience presenting to executive audiences.

  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent, high-priority programs in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience delivering hyperscale AI infrastructure, cloud infrastructure, data centers, semiconductor manufacturing, or other large-scale industrial infrastructure programs.

  • Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), product industrialization, production ramp, or operational readiness for hardware or infrastructure systems.

  • Experience working with OEMs, suppliers, manufacturing partners, EPCs, utilities, cloud providers, developers, or other external infrastructure partners.

  • Experience coordinating engineering development through manufacturing, supply planning, logistics, construction, commissioning, and operational deployment.

  • Experience developing governance frameworks, operational analytics, executive reporting, and scalable operating mechanisms within rapidly growing organizations.

  • PMP, PgMP, Agile, or equivalent program management certifications are a plus but not required.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Overview

For most SMBs, the phone remains one of the highest-intent customer channels. A call may represent a new lead, an urgent service request, a customer trying to book an appointment, a patient looking for help, a buyer asking a final question, or an existing customer who needs immediate support. When the call goes unanswered, the opportunity is often lost.

Most SMBs cannot staff every phone line, department, location, and language around the clock. Traditional IVRs frustrate callers, outsourced answering services lack business context, and human teams spend significant time handling repetitive conversations. HighLevel's Voice AI product is designed to change that.

Voice AI enables businesses to deploy intelligent phone agents that can answer inbound calls, initiate outbound calls, understand caller intent, hold natural conversations, answer questions from business knowledge, qualify leads, collect structured information, book appointments, trigger workflows, interact with external systems, route callers between specialised AI agents, transfer calls to humans, and complete follow-up actions.

We are hiring a Principal Product Manager to define and lead the next generation of this platform. This person will own the long-term product strategy, architecture, quality bar, evaluation system, commercial model, and operating metrics required to make Voice AI dependable across millions of real-world phone conversations.

This is not a prompt-management or chatbot-feature role. It is a senior individual-contributor product leadership role requiring deep systems thinking across AI, voice, telephony, automation, CRM, reliability, compliance, and business outcomes. You will influence multiple product and engineering teams, make platform-level trade-offs, and establish Voice AI as one of the most trusted and commercially important products in the HighLevel ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

● Define and drive the long-term vision, strategy, roadmap, and platform architecture for HighLevel Voice AI.

● Own the complete Voice AI lifecycle, including agent creation, prompts, system instructions, voice and model selection, knowledge, actions, testing, deployment, phone routing, inbound and outbound calling, transfers, analytics, permissions, APIs, billing, and optimisation.

● Establish the product principles that determine when a Voice AI agent should answer, ask a clarifying question, retrieve knowledge, take an action, transfer to another agent, transfer to a human, schedule follow-up, or end the call.

● Develop a deep understanding of agencies, SMBs, franchises, multi-location businesses, and call-intensive industries such as home services, healthcare and wellness, legal, real estate, automotive, insurance, financial services, fitness, hospitality, and professional services.

● Personally review real call recordings, transcripts, latency traces, action logs, failed calls, support tickets, customer configurations, implementation challenges, and measurable business outcomes.

● Translate ambiguous customer and platform problems into strategic choices, product requirements, system models, phased roadmaps, quality standards, and measurable success criteria.

● Partner closely with engineering and AI leadership on streaming architecture, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voice activity detection, turn detection, interruption handling, LLM orchestration, tool invocation, context management, retrieval, caching, latency, reliability, model selection, and cost.

● Partner closely with Phone System and infrastructure teams on call routing, number provisioning, carrier integrations, Twilio and LC Phone behaviour, recording, transfers, forwarding, voicemail, call status, and telephony failure modes.

● Establish a scalable evaluation and release framework for model, prompt, voice, retrieval, action, routing, and infrastructure changes.

● Define production service expectations across call-answer rates, connection success, response latency, audio quality, uptime, action reliability, transfer reliability, and graceful degradation.

● Partner with Design to simplify agent creation, voice selection, prompt configuration, testing, deployment, debugging, analytics, optimisation, and reuse.

● Make Prompt Evaluator, Edit with AI, Prompt Optimiser, Web Call testing, phone testing, and production logs part of a coherent agent-quality workflow.

● Improve integrations between Voice AI and Contacts, Conversations, Calendars, Workflows, Opportunities, Knowledge Base, Payments, Custom Fields, Custom Objects, Phone System, and Reporting.

● Define the architecture and customer experience for multi-agent transfers, human transfers, context handoffs, specialist reuse, fallback behaviour, and merged post-call outputs.

● Develop observability and debugging experiences that expose call state, latency, transcripts, retrieved knowledge, model behaviour, tool calls, parameter extraction, action responses, transfers, carrier errors, and execution timelines.

● Define instrumentation across the full funnel, including agent creation, configuration completion, first test, first successful test, number assignment, first live call, first successful action, sustained usage, business outcomes, retention, and expansion.

● Define operational metrics for inbound and outbound Voice AI, distinguishing between dialling, connection, conversation, qualification, execution, transfer, and business-outcome success.

● Partner with Legal, Compliance, Trust, and Security on consent, disclosures, voice cloning, recording, data processing, retention, outbound calling, sensitive information, fraud, abuse, and platform safeguards.

● Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, use cases, competitive differentiation, customer education, vertical templates, launches, and agency enablement.

● Partner with Support, Implementation, Account Management, Trial Experience, Affiliates, and agency-facing teams to reduce setup friction, improve deployment quality, and lower support burden.

● Partner with Finance and Revenue Experience on pricing, included usage, overages, agency rebilling, model costs, telephony costs, gross margin, budget protection, and sustainable commercial limits.

● Drive strategy across the broader AI Employee portfolio so Voice AI works coherently with Conversation AI, Knowledge Base, Agent Studio, Ask AI, Workflows, Calendars, and future AI-agent capabilities.

● Evaluate external models, voice providers, telephony vendors, infrastructure components, and potential strategic partnerships.

● Act as a senior product thought partner to Product, Engineering, Design, Data, GTM, Finance, Legal, and executive leadership.

● Mentor PMs and raise the quality of product strategy, AI evaluation, systems thinking, and decision-making across the organisation without relying on formal authority.

Ideal Candidate Profile

● 12+ years of product management experience owning complex B2B SaaS, Voice AI, conversational AI, communications, contact-centre, telephony, CRM, workflow-automation, or AI-agent products. Scope and demonstrated outcomes matter more than a precise number of years.

● Prior experience operating as a Principal PM, Staff PM, Lead PM, product founder, or equivalent senior individual contributor responsible for a business-critical product or platform.

● Evidence of defining strategy across multiple teams and delivering sustained customer and commercial outcomes — not only shipping individual features.

● Experience building or operating production AI-agent systems that interact with real customers and take actions inside business workflows.

● Strong understanding of the difference between an impressive voice demonstration and a reliable production calling product.

● Technical fluency across several of the following:

○ Speech-to-text and automatic speech recognition

○ Text-to-speech and voice models

○ Streaming audio

○ Voice activity and end-of-turn detection

○ Barge-in and interruption handling

● Strong customer instincts and willingness to inspect recordings, transcripts, traces, failed calls, implementation issues, and support data personally.

title: Staff Product Manager – Agency Monetization & Wallet
description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Role Overview:
As the Staff Product Manager for Agency Monetization & Wallet, you will own the strategy and execution of HighLevel’s Reselling, Rebilling, and Wallet experiences for agencies and subaccounts.

You will be responsible for how agencies recover platform costs, apply markups, resell HighLevel products, manage funds, and understand the movement of money across their accounts and customers.

This role sits at the intersection of monetization, billing, payments infrastructure, and agency operations. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Finance, Revenue Operations, Tax, and product teams across HighLevel to build a reliable and scalable system that enables agencies to monetize HighLevel products while maintaining financial accuracy, transparency, and control.

Your work will shape how agencies and subaccounts transact across HighLevel—from wallet funding and usage deductions to rebilling, markups, taxes, credits, and profitability visibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for HighLevel's Reselling, Rebilling, and Wallet platform.
  • Identify customer problems and market opportunities to improve how agencies monetize HighLevel products and manage financial operations.
  • Lead product initiatives from discovery through execution, balancing customer needs, technical complexity, and business objectives.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design to build scalable, reliable, and intuitive platform experiences.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and other Product teams to ensure seamless end-to-end monetization workflows.
  • Define success metrics, leverage customer insights and data, and continuously optimize product performance.
  • Drive alignment across stakeholders while influencing product direction across multiple teams.
  • Mentor Product Managers and contribute to raising the overall product management bar across the organization.

What You'll Own
You will own the end-to-end experience across:
  • Reselling Platform
  • Rebilling Platform
  • Agency Wallet
  • Subaccount Wallet
  • Wallet Funding & Auto Recharge
  • Transaction History & Financial Transparency
  • Credits, Refunds & Adjustments
  • Markups & Margin Management
  • Agency Tax Experience
  • Wallet APIs & Platform Services
  • Monetization Frameworks consumed by product teams

What You'll Do
  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for HighLevel's Reselling, Rebilling, and Wallet products.
  • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from customer discovery and strategy through execution, launch, and continuous improvement.
  • Build products that simplify how agencies monetize HighLevel, manage billing workflows, and operate their businesses.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Finance, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and other Product teams to deliver scalable, customer-centric solutions.
  • Drive product decisions by leveraging customer research, market insights, experimentation, and data.
  • Balance customer needs, business objectives, technical complexity, and platform scalability to deliver high-impact outcomes.
  • Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and continuously improve customer experience through data-driven iteration.
  • Influence product direction across multiple teams and align stakeholders around a shared product vision.
  • Mentor Product Managers and contribute to strengthening product strategy, execution, and product management best practices across the organization.

Requirement:
  • 8+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of complex financial or payments infrastructure in SaaS or fintech environments.
  • Proven ability to design, ship, and scale systems that handle large volumes of financial transactions and reconciliations.
  • Deep understanding of Stripe’s ecosystem — including Connected Accounts, Treasury, Payment Intents, Tax APIs, and reconciliation workflows.
  • Strong grasp of global payments, multi-currency management, and FX settlement across regions (US, EU, Canada, India, Australia).
  • Experience implementing or integrating tax compliance systems (e.g., Stripe Tax, Avalara, or internal frameworks) for B2B and reseller transactions.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across finance, tax, and engineering teams to ensure accounting accuracy and regulatory alignment.
  • High comfort with hands-on execution — including data validation, variance analysis, and mapping product usage to revenue.
  • Analytical mindset with experience using SQL, BI tools, or financial data models to diagnose issues and validate hypotheses.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial concepts for cross-functional audiences.
  • Track record of driving measurable impact through systemic improvements, automation, and data-driven decisions.

Nice-to-Have
  • Prior experience building or managing usage-based billing or embedded finance platforms.
  • Familiarity with accounting systems (NetSuite, Chargebee, QuickBooks) and their integration with payment data pipelines.
  • Understanding of reseller ecosystems, margin management, and agency billing workflows.
  • Experience with cross-border compliance and digital goods taxation (VAT, GST, HST).
  • Exposure to financial ledger design, double-entry accounting models, or journal reconciliation automation.
  • Strong technical fluency with APIs, data pipelines, and internal tools related to payments and finance.
  • Background in high-scale SaaS or fintech environments (e.g., Stripe, Shopify, Adyen, PayPal, or B2B billing systems).
  • Experience operating in remote, global teams with complex stakeholder alignment across functions and time zones.


Why Join HighLevel?
At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company.

Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.

You will architect and scale our native Call Center features, developing sophisticated routing logic, agent workspaces, and queue management systems.

This role sits at the intersection of communications infrastructure, telecom engineering, voice automation, contact center operations, and platform scale. You will partner closely with Engineering, Operations, Product, Support, and external communication providers to build the next generation of HighLevel's voice platform.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Own the vision, strategy and execution for HighLevel's HardPhone, SIP, IVR, Call Center and Enterprise Voice platforms.
  • Build a scalable, provider-agnostic communications platform that abstracts multiple CPaaS providers through a unified architecture.
  • Architect and scale sophisticated Automatic Call Distributor (ACD) capabilities, including skills-based routing, priority queues, ring groups, overflow rules, business hours and failover logic.
  • Design intuitive softphone experiences across web and mobile, along with real-time supervisor dashboards for monitoring, coaching and workforce management.
  • Own the complete lifecycle of HardPhone provisioning, including Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP), remote configuration, firmware management, inventory management and device lifecycle operations.
  • Drive the evolution of IVR and Voice AI, including drag-and-drop workflow builders, conversational AI, speech recognition, call transcription, agent assistance, and call summarization.
  • Build enterprise telephony capabilities including call recording, voicemail, conferencing, whisper/barge, monitoring, queue management and compliance recording.
  • Define extensible Voice APIs, SDKs, webhooks and event frameworks that enable seamless integrations with third-party applications and ecosystem partners.
  • Lead customer migration initiatives, including provider migrations, number portability, hosted phone onboarding, and enterprise telephony transitions, while minimizing customer disruption.
  • Partner with Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Compliance, Support and Go-to-Market teams to deliver highly reliable, globally scalable voice products.
  • Establish and monitor platform KPIs including call completion rates, SIP reliability, provisioning success, IVR containment, routing efficiency, call quality (MOS), queue abandonment, agent utilization, billing accuracy, platform availability and customer satisfaction (CSAT).
  • Develop and execute the long-term roadmap for enterprise telephony, AI-powered communications, multi-vendor architecture and next-generation voice experiences, ensuring HighLevel maintains competitive parity and platform leadership.
Requirement:
  • 8+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of communications, telecommunications, voice infrastructure, CPaaS, CCaaS or enterprise platform products.
  • Deep understanding of SIP, RTP, WebRTC, VoIP, IVR, enterprise telephony, and contact center ecosystems.
  • Proven experience building communications infrastructure or voice platform products at scale, including Automatic Call Distributor (ACD), intelligent routing and Call Center functionality.
  • Strong understanding of SIP endpoint management, HardPhone provisioning, remote device management, and telephony lifecycle management.
  • Experience working directly with CPaaS providers, telecom operators, hardware vendors, or communications infrastructure platforms.
  • Experience building multi-provider routing, abstraction layers, middleware, or API-first platform products.
  • Experience designing scalable multi-tenant platforms and highly available distributed systems serving enterprise customers.
  • Strong understanding of intelligent routing, least-cost routing (LCR), provider redundancy, failover mechanisms, and global telephony architecture.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills, with experience defining platform KPIs and using analytics to drive product strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to define long-term platform strategy, influence executive stakeholders, and lead cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Infrastructure, Finance, Operations, and Go-to-Market teams.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and prioritization skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.
Nice-to-Have:
  • Familiarity with SIP infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience building conversational AI, speech recognition, voice automation, AI-powered call routing or agent assist capabilities.
  • Familiarity with STIR/SHAKEN, CNAM, E911, number portability, hosted numbers (BYOC/BYON), and regulatory compliance across global telephony markets.
  • Experience building contact center (CCaaS) capabilities such as workforce management, quality monitoring, call recording, coaching, and supervisor tools.
  • Experience working with event-driven architectures, APIs, SDKs, and developer platforms for communications products.
  • Understanding of enterprise security, privacy, and compliance requirements for voice platforms, including GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or similar standards.
Core KPIs:
  • Voice Platform Reliability – SIP session success rate, call completion rate, provider failover success.
  • Call Center Efficiency – Queue Abandonment Rate, Average Handle Time (AHT), Agent Utilization.
  • HardPhone Provisioning – Device onboarding success rate, provisioning time, firmware deployment success.
  • IVR Performance – IVR containment rate, workflow completion, conversational AI adoption.
  • Routing Efficiency – Least-cost routing optimization, latency reduction, provider utilization.
Why Join HighLevel?
At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters. Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well funded & profitable company. Join us at High Level, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

description:

OpenAI's Human Data Team creates custom data solutions driving groundbreaking research. Our work enhances and evaluates our flagship models and products like ChatGPT, GPT-5, and Sora, and contributes to safety initiatives through collaboration with our Preparedness and Safety Systems teams.

About the Role

As a Research Program Manager (RPM) in the Human Data team you will partner with research and engineering to design and implement pragmatic solutions for collecting high-quality data. You will be a key interface between our research roadmap, external vendors, AI trainers, and the Human Data engineering team.

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ.

In this role, you will:

  • Collaborate with Research: Partner with researchers to scope data collection needs, define success metrics, and establish quality measurement frameworks.

  • Design & Execute Data Collection Campaigns: Translate research needs into actionable plans and accelerate execution by leveraging existing tooling and iterating to reach the desired outcome. In many cases, you will need to implement scrappy new solutions while partnering with engineering to design robust/scalable solutions.

  • Unblock Yourself: You must be deeply uncomfortable with the idea of sitting around waiting for external dependencies, and have the technical acumen and drive to figure out how to achieve at least partial success in the interim.

  • Optimize Systems & Processes: Build and optimize dashboards to track campaign performance, leveraging SQL and Python for data analysis and actionable insights.

  • Drive Technical Roadmaps: Collaborate with engineers to enhance data platforms, resolve blockers, and ensure security best practices such as access management.

  • Scale Your Impact: Advise and empower program managers and vendors to drive day-to-day execution so that you can focus on addressing high priority opportunities.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are excited to understand the technicalities of cutting edge AI research and work alongside researchers from instantiation to launch.

  • Enjoy being part of an ambitious and technically-minded team.

description:
Technical Program Manager – Applied Product & Platform

About the Team

The Product & Platform teams at OpenAI are responsible for delivering the company’s most impactful offerings—such as ChatGPT, our API platform, and new enterprise capabilities—to a global and diverse customer base. These systems must perform at scale and deliver exceptional experiences to developers, consumers, and businesses alike.

Technical Program Managers at OpenAI play a key leadership role in scaling these efforts, partnering deeply with product, engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to bring ambitious ideas to life and ensure clarity and discipline in execution.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive complex, large-scale product and platform initiatives across ChatGPT, API, and related surfaces. This role sits at the intersection of technical strategy and execution. You’ll be responsible for translating product vision into actionable plans, shaping interfaces and experiences from both consumer and developer perspectives, and ensuring successful delivery across web, mobile, and platform layers.

You’ll bring deep technical fluency, product sense, and a strong execution track record. You’re comfortable managing ambiguity, influencing architectural direction, advocating for developers, and leading cross-functional delivery with discipline and empathy.

Location: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid – 3 days/week in-office)

In this role, you will:

  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and design to shape roadmaps, technical strategies, and long-term platform direction.

  • Translate product vision into clear, scalable technical execution plans, balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform evolution.

  • Lead end-to-end execution of cross-functional product and platform programs—from planning through launch and iteration.

  • Own timelines, milestones, dependency management, risk mitigation, and accountability across teams.

  • Partner with engineering teams to influence architectural decisions and interface definitions for public and internal APIs.

  • Understand full-stack systems across client (web, mobile) and server (API, back-end) surfaces to ensure holistic and performant solutions.

  • Serve as a central coordination point across product, design, engineering, legal, policy, and go-to-market stakeholders.

  • Ensure alignment on priorities and unblock teams through structured execution and consistent communication.

  • Deliver crisp and clear updates to technical and executive stakeholders on program health, risks, and tradeoffs.

title: Staff Product Manager – Voice AI
description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs, and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate, and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value. By centralizing conversations, automation, intelligence, and customer operations into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity, and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily, with 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices, and over 1 million domain names supported. The architecture is built for performance, resilience, and long-term scalability.

Our people

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads, and 20 million conversations for more than 1 million businesses. Behind those numbers are agencies, entrepreneurs, and SMBs building independence, expanding opportunity, and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Why This Role Exists

Voice is one of the highest-intent customer interaction channels for SMBs. Missed calls, delayed follow-ups, poor qualification, inconsistent appointment booking, and manual outbound outreach directly translate into lost revenue for local businesses and agencies.

HighLevel’s VoiceAI product is designed to change that.

VoiceAI enables businesses to deploy AI-powered voice agents that can answer inbound calls, hold natural conversations, collect customer information, book appointments, trigger workflows, send post-call summaries, and support both phone-based and browser-based voice experiences. VoiceAI also supports outbound calling from workflows for use cases like lead follow-up, appointment outreach, prospect engagement, and reactivation campaigns.

The Staff Product Manager – VoiceAI will own the strategy, execution, and quality bar for one of HighLevel’s most important AI products. This role sits at the intersection of AI agents, telephony, CRM, workflow automation, knowledge retrieval, compliance, analytics, and user experience.

You will be expected to deeply understand agencies, local businesses, call-heavy industries, and the real operational jobs that VoiceAI must perform: answer calls, qualify leads, route conversations, book appointments, follow up, summarize outcomes, and help businesses scale without adding headcount.

This is not a generic AI PM role. This is a hands-on, technically fluent, customer-obsessed product leadership role for someone who can build a reliable, scalable, commercially meaningful AI voice product inside a complex, high-volume SaaS platform.

Strategic Priorities

  • Make VoiceAI the default AI receptionist for SMBs: Build a product that reliably handles inbound calls, understands caller intent, answers questions, captures lead information, books appointments, and escalates when needed.

  • Scale outbound VoiceAI responsibly: Build workflow-driven outbound calling for lead follow-up, appointment reminders, reactivation, and prospect engagement while respecting platform limits, consent requirements, call quality, and compliance obligations. HighLevel’s current outbound VoiceAI supports workflow-based calls, up to 1,000 outbound VoiceAI calls per location per day, and time-zone-based scheduling between 8 AM and 8 PM based on the contact’s phone-number timezone.

  • Improve agent setup and time-to-value: Simplify agent creation, phone number assignment, prompt configuration, knowledge base selection, working hours, call actions, testing, and deployment so agencies can launch high-quality VoiceAI agents for clients quickly.

  • Drive call quality, reliability, and trust: Improve latency, interruption handling, speech recognition, natural conversation quality, escalation logic, call summaries, transcripts, recordings, and post-call workflows.

  • Deepen CRM and workflow integration: Ensure VoiceAI can update contact records, trigger workflows, generate summaries, collect structured fields, and feed downstream automation. VoiceAI currently supports post-call workflow triggers, email notifications, call summaries, contact information, transcripts, and actions taken.

  • Build VoiceAI as a platform capability: Advance public APIs, webhooks, call logs, agent configuration APIs, action APIs, voice catalog APIs, and developer-facing extensibility so agencies and developers can build repeatable voice agent solutions at scale.

  • Support multilingual and brand-personalized voice experiences: Expand use cases across languages, voices, locales, and branded voice experiences. HighLevel VoiceAI supports multi-language configuration and a voice library, and voice cloning is currently available in Labs for creating on-brand custom voices.

  • Own VoiceAI monetization and adoption: Work closely with Product Marketing, Support, Trial Experience, Implementation, Account Management, Affiliates, RevEx, and Finance to drive activation, usage, retention, packaging, and revenue for VoiceAI and AI Employee plans. VoiceAI is part of HighLevel’s AI pricing structure across pay-per-use, AI Employee Growth, and AI Employee Unlimited plans.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and success metrics for HighLevel VoiceAI.

  • Own the full VoiceAI product surface, including inbound calling, outbound calling, web/widget voice experiences, agent setup, prompt configuration, voice selection, call actions, testing, analytics, call logs, summaries, transcripts, and workflow integrations.

  • Deeply understand customer use cases across agencies, SMBs, and high-call-volume verticals such as home services, medical spas, fitness, legal, real estate, insurance, dental, automotive, and local professional services.

  • Translate customer problems into clear product requirements, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, launch plans, and measurable success metrics.

  • Partner closely with engineering on telephony architecture, LLM behavior, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency, call routing, retries, failure handling, observability, and infrastructure scalability.

  • Work with design to simplify VoiceAI setup, agent testing, debugging, prompt management, call review, and performance reporting.

  • Build strong integrations between VoiceAI, Contacts, Conversations, Calendars, Workflows, Opportunities, Payments, Knowledge Base, Custom Values, and AI Employee.

  • Improve the quality of AI agent behavior through better prompts, guardrails, prompt evaluation, knowledge retrieval, call simulations, QA workflows, and customer feedback loops.

  • Define instrumentation across activation, agent creation, test calls, phone number assignment, first successful call, call completion rate, booking rate, human escalation rate, workflow trigger rate, outbound answer rate, transcript quality, cost per successful outcome, revenue, retention, and support ticket trends.

  • Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, GTM, use-case packaging, launch readiness, help docs, enablement, and agency-facing education.

  • Partner with Support, Implementation, Trial Experience, Account Management, and Affiliates to identify friction, improve onboarding, reduce ticket volume, and make VoiceAI easier to sell, configure, and support.

  • Own compliance-sensitive product decisions around outbound calling, consent, KYC requirements, acceptable use, timezone restrictions, call recording, transcripts, data handling, and abuse prevention.

  • Use customer calls, support tickets, NPS/CSAT, ideas board feedback, usage analytics, and call quality reviews to continuously improve the product.

  • Act as the product thought partner to engineering leadership for VoiceAI architecture, platform extensibility, reliability, and scale.

What Success Looks Like

  • Agencies can launch useful VoiceAI agents for their clients quickly, without needing heavy technical setup or prompt engineering expertise.

  • VoiceAI becomes a meaningful revenue and retention driver inside the broader AI Employee offering.

  • Inbound VoiceAI reliably handles common SMB calls: FAQs, lead qualification, appointment booking, missed-call recovery, basic routing, and follow-up.

  • Outbound VoiceAI becomes a scalable and trusted workflow action for follow-up, reactivation, reminders, and lead conversion.

  • Customers see measurable business value: fewer missed calls, faster response times, more booked appointments, higher lead conversion, and reduced manual work.

  • VoiceAI quality improves consistently across latency, naturalness, interruption handling, accuracy, escalation, summaries, transcripts, and workflow outcomes.

  • Support tickets per active VoiceAI location decrease as setup, debugging, permissions, billing clarity, and documentation improve.

  • VoiceAI becomes more extensible through APIs, webhooks, reusable templates, marketplace assets, and better developer/admin tooling.

  • Internal teams clearly understand what VoiceAI does, how to sell it, how to support it, and how to measure success.

  • You are viewed as the strategic and executional anchor for VoiceAI across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Support, Trial Experience, Implementation, Account Management, Affiliates, and RevEx.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 8–12 years of product management experience, with meaningful experience owning complex B2B SaaS, AI, communication, automation, CRM, or platform products.

  • Prior experience as a Staff PM, Principal PM, Lead PM, or equivalent senior IC product role.

  • Strong product judgment in AI-driven user experiences, especially where reliability, trust, latency, and outcome quality matter.

  • Deep fluency in at least one of the following areas: voice AI, contact center software, telephony, conversational AI, workflow automation, CRM, customer communications, AI agents, or developer platforms.

  • Technical enough to work credibly with engineering on LLM behavior, APIs, webhooks, telephony systems, latency, data pipelines, observability, model trade-offs, and scalability.

  • Strong systems thinking: able to connect VoiceAI with contacts, calendars, conversations, workflows, opportunities, knowledge base, billing, permissions, and reporting.

  • Clear understanding of SMB and agency-led SaaS models. Bonus if the candidate has built products for agencies, local businesses, franchises, or multi-location customers.

  • Strong customer empathy and ability to translate messy real-world use cases into simple, scalable product experiences.

  • Strong analytical ability. Can define metrics, diagnose funnel drop-offs, interpret product usage, and separate noisy feedback from real product problems.

  • High ownership and execution velocity. Comfortable operating in a fast-growth, remote-first, high-context environment.

  • Excellent written and asynchronous communication skills. Can write clear PRDs, crisp trade-off documents, launch notes, and executive updates.

  • Comfortable making hard prioritization calls across customer asks, quality improvements, revenue opportunities, technical debt, and compliance constraints.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience building AI agents, voice bots, virtual receptionists, IVR systems, contact center automation, or customer support automation.

  • Experience with speech-to-text, text-to-speech, LLM orchestration, RAG/knowledge retrieval, prompt evaluation, call analytics, or AI quality evaluation.

  • Experience with Twilio, LC Phone-like telephony systems, SIP, call routing, call recording, voicemail, number provisioning, A2P/10DLC, KYC, or telecom compliance.

  • Experience building workflow automation products similar to HighLevel Workflows, Zapier, Make, HubSpot Workflows, Salesforce Flow, or customer journey builders.

  • Experience with appointment-heavy verticals such as home services, healthcare/wellness, dental, legal, real estate, financial services, or local professional services.

  • Experience with marketplace templates, reusable agent configurations, public APIs, developer platforms, or partner ecosystems.

  • Experience with usage-based pricing, AI cost management, fair-use policies, or gross-margin-sensitive AI products.

  • Hands-on familiarity with product performance metrics such as latency, completion rate, containment rate, escalation rate, answer rate, booking conversion, support ticket rate, P95/P99 performance, and cost per successful outcome.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Commerce Operations
description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts


Role Summary
As the Sr. Product Manager for Commerce Operations, you will own the operational backbone of HighLevel's commerce platform - the interconnected systems that govern how orders are created, tracked, and fulfilled; how subscriptions run across their full lifecycle; how transactions are recorded and reconciled; and how inventory, taxation, coupons, and gift cards function reliably at scale. Like the Product Information Management layer, this role sits at the center of the Commerce team: every commerce surface depends on it, internal teams across the company build on it, and the external developer and marketplace ecosystem consumes it through a public API layer that you will define and own. You will also lead the build of HighLevel's internal accounting layer and design the integration surface for users who operate with third-party accounting tools — positioning commerce operations as both the authoritative source of financial truth and an open, compatible platform.

What You'll Do

● Own the Commerce Operations Roadmap: Define and drive the end-to-end product vision across HighLevel's full operations surface - Orders, Subscriptions, Transactions, Inventory, Fulfillment, Taxation, Coupons, and Gift Cards — ensuring each domain is built as a composable, reliable primitive that serves the platform as a whole.

● Build the Subscription Lifecycle: Own how plans, entitlements, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, pauses, and dunning flows work across the platform - building subscription management that handles the full complexity of real SMB billing, from simple recurring charges to tiered, usage-based, and trial-gated plans.

● Define the Ledger & Internal Accounting Layer: Lead the product definition and build of HighLevel's internal accounting layer — the authoritative system of record for every money-in and money-out event - designed from day one as the foundation for embedded accounting that keeps businesses running their books inside HighLevel.

● Enable Third-Party Accounting Compatibility: Design the integration surface that allows users who prefer external accounting software to sync HighLevel commerce data seamlessly - ensuring field mapping accuracy, reconciliation reliability, and a sync experience that requires zero manual intervention.

● Own Order Management & Fulfillment: Define how orders are created, modified, fulfilled, partially fulfilled, returned, and cancelled - building the state machine and merchant-facing workflows that make order operations reliable across every commerce surface, from storefronts to invoices to subscriptions.

● Build for Variable Granularity: Ensure every operational entity - order, fulfillment event, invoice, subscription, payment — is optional and composable. A business running on invoices alone and a business running a full order-fulfillment-invoice-payment chain must both be fully supported, with frictionless paths between granularity levels.

● Lead Inventory Management: Define the inventory layer - stock levels, reservations, adjustments, multi-location support, and low-stock signals - ensuring the platform correctly tracks physical goods across the full commerce lifecycle and exposes inventory state to every consuming surface.

● Shape Taxation & Compliance Infrastructure: Own the product strategy for tax calculation, tax code mapping, and compliance — across transaction types and geographies - ensuring HighLevel handles tax obligations correctly as merchants operate in multiple regions and as the platform expands internationally.

● Define Coupons, Promotions & Gift Cards: Build the discount and gift card infrastructure - coupon creation and validation, promotion rules, gift card issuance and redemption, balance tracking - ensuring these tools are expressive enough for merchant needs while enforcing correct financial accounting at every step.

● Own the Developer & Marketplace API Surface: Define and own the public API layer that external developers, agencies, and marketplace partners consume - ensuring commerce operations APIs are well-designed, stable, versioned, and expressive enough to support the full range of third-party integration and build use cases.

● Drive Cross-Functional Platform Alignment: Collaborate with the PIM, Documents, Onboarding, and Payments teams to ensure the operations layer exposes the primitives they depend on - and that operational events such as order placement, invoice issuance, and subscription renewal trigger the correct downstream behaviors reliably and consistently.

What We're Looking For

● 7+ Years of PM Experience: Proven track record in platform or infrastructure product management at high-growth SaaS companies, with significant exposure to transactional or financial systems.

● Commerce Operations Depth: Deep familiarity with order management, subscription billing, inventory, fulfillment, and transaction or ledger systems - understanding both the underlying data models and the merchant workflows built on top of them.

● Financial Systems Fluency: Comfort reasoning about ledger mechanics, double-entry accounting concepts, reconciliation requirements, and the data integrity standards of systems that carry financial truth for real businesses.

● API & Developer Platform Thinking: Experience building and owning public APIs consumed by external developers — with a strong grasp of contract design, versioning strategies, stability guarantees, and what makes a developer experience genuinely good.

● Platform-First Mindset: Demonstrated ability to design products as shared infrastructure - defining clear contracts, managing internal teams as stakeholders, and consistently prioritizing long-term extensibility over short-term feature velocity.

● Bias for Ownership: Comfortable holding the thread across a broad, interconnected domain without letting complexity become an excuse for slow decisions. Sets direction and drives execution independently.

What you'll get

● Strategic Centrality: Own the operational core that every other commerce surface depends on - a role with platform-wide impact, visibility across every team building on HighLevel's commerce infrastructure, and a direct line to the company's system-of-record ambition.

● High Ownership, Low Bureaucracy: Join an already-assembled engineering and design team and take full ownership of a mission-critical layer, with the autonomy to define the roadmap and drive execution at the pace HighLevel operates.

● Scale: Build the operational infrastructure that powers commerce for over a million businesses across 150+ countries, and define the accounting and developer API layer that will shape how HighLevel's commerce ecosystem grows over the next decade.
